notes: REF-BM-02: only title and favicon are auto-fetched via a regex on raw HTML; no description or preview-image collection. REF-BM-04: url/title/description/tags are editable but there is no 'note' field/entity anywhere in the schema or UI. REF-BM-06: create_bookmark always INSERTs a new row; no url-lookup/dedup check exists before insert. REF-BM-10: tags are a single plain-text comma-separated input with no datalist/autocomplete wiring. REF-BM-12: search covers title/url/description via SQL LIKE but there is no note field to include. REF-BM-14: no '#tag' token parsing in the query string, tags are only filterable via the separate tag-cloud click/?tag= param, not inline search syntax. REF-BM-15: no boolean operator/parenthesis parser; query is a single raw LIKE substring. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase handling, same raw-substring limitation. REF-BM-17/18/19: no unread/read flag exists in the bookmarks table or API. REF-BM-20/21: no multi-select checkboxes or bulk-action endpoints in app.js or main.py. REF-BM-22: list is hard-ordered by created_at/id desc with no user-selectable sort key. REF-BM-23: no note field, so no markdown authoring or rendering. REF-BM-24/25: no snapshot capture (HTML/PDF) or Internet Archive integration. REF-BM-26/27/28: no archived flag or archive list/endpoint. REF-BM-29: no bundle entity or saved-filter endpoint. REF-BM-30/31: import/export both operate on a custom JSON array shape, not Netscape HTML. REF-BM-32: no settings entity, endpoint, or UI for sort/page-size/font-size.
